maria: Quick brainstorm 10m7 on policy sim UX. core asks: instant client-side "preview" vs accurate server sim. tradeoffs?
kevin: preview for exploration (health slider + presets). server sim for validation before apply. keep both.
olivia: UX copy: show "Preview (estimate)" vs "Full simulation (uses real traffic)". also add a small confidence badge.
sam: telemetry needs: sim run id, input profile, top triggers, projected fallback_rate, cost_delta, CI bounds. store run for audit.
maria: where to show sim history? under policy > runs tab with timestamps + author + small diff. include "replay" button.
kevin: UI detail: when rollout <100% show per-% expected fallback delta tooltip. tiny sparkline.
osim-bot: sim job queued id=sim-9012  ETA 2m. results -> thread when done.
maria: action items: kevin -> add preview + run buttons; olivia -> copy for badges; sam -> sim telemetry spec. sync Fri 11am.
maria: thanks :thumbsup:
